scientific.integrity: The classification follows from exact fixed-point reduction and Vieta/discriminant signs. Two rational counterexamples and direct map substitution are replayed by bundled code. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies strictly positive fixed points of the autonomous source map. It does not classify local stability of both coexistence branches, global dynamics, or bifurcation behavior in the two-root regime.

title: Exact coexistence classification for a discrete fear-modulated predator-prey map
